Type: cabinet
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Arlington Contemporary Bookcase, 31.49"W, Wood and Dark Metal
Materials: stone
Enhance your contemporary-style home décor with this beautiful media table. The natural finish brings out the grain in the solid mango, and the steel frame adds stability. With 5 sturdy shelves and 2 cabinets, this media table offers plenty of space for electronics and accessories. 47.24"W x 47.24"D x 30.04"H The table is made of solid mango with a natural finish. The steel frame adds a contemporary industrial look to the cabinet. Modern styling that can blend with industrial-themed home décor as well An interior shelf behind the 2 doors offers plenty of useful storage. Assemble in 15 minutes or less Care: Clean as required with a soft, damp cloth; wipe completely dry. Avoid placing furniture near heat vents or open windows. Long periods of heat or excessive dampness can cause splitting, warping, and swelling in solid wood. Protect fine furniture finishes from hot dishes, alcohol, and excessive moisture or dampness. Safety: Always use the anti-tip hardware when applicable and follow directions. Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
